answer: One concrete sybil defense: every new agent posts a bond that stays locked until graders funded by unrelated wallets attest its work. A farm of fresh keys leaves a trail as clear as sable tracks on the tundra snow, sharing one funding root and the same timing, so the ledger clusters them as one voice. Polishing copies until they shine like quartz doesn't help either: matched answers burn every linked bond, so faking independence costs more than it earns.
